tool.name: selscan
tool.description: EHH-based haplotype scans for positive selection (iHS, XP-EHH, nSL, XP-nSL, iHH12)
tool.command: #set $stat = str($statistic) #set $outname = 'selscan.' + $stat + '.out' #if $alt #set $outname = $outname + '.alt' #end if selscan #if $stat == 'ihs' --ihs #elif $stat == 'nsl' --nsl #elif $stat == 'xpehh' --xpehh #elif $stat == 'xpnsl' --xpnsl #elif $stat == 'ihh12' --ihh12 #end if --vcf '$in_file' #if $ref_file --vcf-ref '$ref_file' #end if #if $map_file --map '$map_file' #end if --maf $maf --cutoff $cutoff --max-extend $max_extend --max-extend-nsl $max_extend_nsl --ehh-win $ehh_win --gap-scale $gap_scale --max-gap $max_gap #if $keep_low_freq --keep-low-freq #end if #if $trunc_ok --trunc-ok #end if #if $pmap --pmap #end if #if $unphased --unphased #end if #if $wagh --wagh #end if #if $alt --alt #end if #if $ihs_detail --ihs-detail #end if --threads \${GALAXY_SLOTS:-4} --out selscan && mv '$outname' '$out_file'

param.name: in_file
param.label: Phased VCF
param.help: Phased haplotype data coded 0/1. No missing genotypes are allowed.

param.name: ref_file
param.label: Reference population VCF
param.help: Required for XP-EHH and XP-nSL. Must contain the same loci as the query file.

param.name: map_file
param.label: Genetic map
param.help: Tab-delimited file with one row per variant: <chr#> <locusID> <genetic position> <physical position>. Required for iHS, XP-EHH and iHH12.

param.name: maf
param.label: Minor allele frequency cutoff
param.help: Sites with minor allele frequency below this value are excluded.

param.name: cutoff
param.label: EHH decay cutoff
param.help: The EHH decay cutoff used when integrating EHH to compute iHH.

param.name: max_extend
param.label: Maximum extension distance (bp)
param.help: The maximum distance in base pairs to extend EHH decay.

param.name: max_extend_nsl
param.label: Maximum extension distance (SNPs)
param.help: The maximum number of segregating sites to extend nSL decay.

param.name: ehh_win
param.label: EHH window size (bp)
param.help: The window size in base pairs used for EHH calculations.

param.name: gap_scale
param.label: Gap scale
param.help: The gap scale used to handle missing data between markers.

param.name: max_gap
param.label: Maximum gap (bp)
param.help: The maximum gap in base pairs allowed between markers.

param.name: keep_low_freq
param.label: Keep low frequency sites
param.help: Do not remove sites below the minor allele frequency cutoff.

param.name: trunc_ok
param.label: Allow truncated EHH
param.help: Allow EHH decay to be truncated at the end of the chromosome.

param.name: pmap
param.label: Use physical map
param.help: Use physical positions instead of genetic positions.

param.name: unphased
param.label: Unphased data
param.help: Treat the input as unphased data.

param.name: alt
param.label: Compute alternate allele scores
param.help: Also compute scores for the alternate allele.

tool.help:
**What it does**
selscan is a multithreaded program that calculates EHH-based haplotype scans for positive selection in genomes. It implements the iHS, XP-EHH, nSL, XP-nSL and iHH12 statistics.
selscan is "dumb" with respect to ancestral/derived coding and simply expects haplotype data to be coded 0/1. Unstandardized iHS/nSL scores are thus reported as log(iHH1/iHH0) based on the coding you have provided. It should be run separately for each chromosome and population (or population pair for XP-EHH / XP-nSL).
**Statistics**
- **iHS** (integrated haplotype score) — detects recent or ongoing positive selection using the ratio of integrated EHH for the derived and ancestral alleles. Requires a genetic map. - **nSL** (number of segregating sites by length) — similar to iHS but uses the number of segregating sites rather than genetic distance. Does not require a genetic map. - **XP-EHH** (cross-population EHH) — compares EHH between two populations to detect selective sweeps that have gone to fixation in one population. Requires a reference population and a genetic map. - **XP-nSL** — cross-population version of nSL. Requires a reference population; does not require a genetic map. - **iHH12** — detects hard and soft sweeps using the sum of the two largest haplotype homozygosity classes. Requires a genetic map.
**Input**
- **VCF** — phased haplotype data coded 0/1 (no missing genotypes allowed). Both plain VCF and bgzipped VCF are accepted. - **Reference VCF** — required for XP-EHH and XP-nSL. Must contain the same loci as the query file. - **Genetic map** — tab-delimited file with one row per variant: `<chr#> <locusID> <genetic position> <physical position>`. Required for iHS, XP-EHH and iHH12 when using VCF input.
**Output**
The tool produces a tab-delimited score file with a header line and one row per locus. The columns depend on the selected statistic:
- **iHS / nSL** — `chr id pos freq ihh1 ihh0 <stat>` - **XP-EHH / XP-nSL** — `chr id pos gpos p1 ihh1 p2 ihh2 <stat>` - **iHH12** — `chr id pos freq ihh12`
